extracted.name: Corn and Onion Pattie Fried Fritters
extracted.description: This minimal ingredient recipe is easy to whip together with things found in your pantry. Super tasty and beloved by my family. #KitchenStaplesRemix
ingredient_lines: 4 tbsp (add gradually) All-purpose flour (add more as needed)
4 tbs or enough for shallow frying Peanut oil (or vegetable oil)
instruction_lines: Combine canned corn (with juice) and diced sweet onion in a bowl.
Add flour 1 tbsp at a time, mixing until a loose, pancake-like batter forms.
Stir in salt and onion powder.
Heat peanut oil in a pan over medium heat.
Drop spoonfuls of batter to form small patties. Fry until golden and crispy on both sides.
Drain on paper towels before serving.
